title: Vineyard Partition
body:
A vineyard is a grid with 2 rows and n columns. o is a free plot and x is blocked. The free plots form at most one connected region (4-neighbourhood).

Count the free plots that, if blocked, would split the free plots into exactly three connected regions.

Function to complete

Complete countPartitions(field). It returns the answer described above.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
cons: Each row has exactly n characters, o or x

samples.ex: Blocking the bottom plot in column 2 or column 4 (0-indexed) splits the free plots into three regions.
Blocking the middle top plot leaves three single plots.
